name: Derek Schmidt

accounts.evidence: Derek Schmidt's campaign website links to https://x.com/derekschmidtks in its header and footer, alongside Facebook and Instagram accounts with the same name.

notes: A search summary also cited a 2024 post at x.com/DerekSchmidtKS, which is the same handle with different capitalization.

name: Sharice Davids

accounts.evidence: The campaign website's Twitter icon links to shariceforcongress.com/twitter, which redirects with a 301 to https://x.com/ShariceDavids.

notes: The handle comes from the redirect target of the campaign site's own /twitter link. x.com was not opened.

accounts.evidence: The Estes for Congress campaign website links to https://twitter.com/ronestesks at the top of the page, next to its Facebook and YouTube links.

name: James Comer

accounts.evidence: The Branch voter guide profile for James Comer in the 2026 Kentucky 1st District general election lists his campaign site jamescomer.com and the X account https://x.com/JamesComer.

notes: Medium confidence: the evidence comes from a third-party voter guide (Branch), not his own site. His campaign site jamescomer.com links only to Facebook (kycomerforcongress) and has no X link. The account type is uncertain: it could be personal or campaign.

Morgan McGarvey's campaign website links to https://twitter.com/MorganMcGarvey in its header and footer, alongside the MorganMcGarveyForCongress Facebook page.

name: Thomas Massie

name: Harold Rogers
notes: The campaign site congressmanhalrogers.com (paid for by Hal Rogers for Congress) has no X link, only Facebook (HalRogersForCongress). The Branch voter guide lists only RepHalRogers, which is already on file. No separate personal or campaign X account was found.
